paragraphs: Since the day you said yes, your head has been full of venues, guest lists, matching outfit colours and a hundred little decisions. I couldn’t plan your wedding for you, but I could build something that carries the weight with you.

So this is my wedding gift: a planner that listens. Tell it what’s on your mind, and it keeps the list, minds the budget, counts down the days and talks you through what’s next, so you can spend less time worrying and more time enjoying every moment before you walk down that aisle.
signoff: With all my love, your best friend,
name: Kane
